newsitem.title: USA: Cycomm gets Philadelphia PCMobile order.
newsitem.headline: Cycomm gets Philadelphia PCMobile order.

text.p: Cycomm International Inc said on Monday that the city of Philadelphia has ordered 120 PCMobile Units worth $500,000 from the company's wholly owned subsidiary, XL Computing Corp.

The initial order, to be delivered in the first half of 1997, is the first phase of a 525 PCMobile unit deployment with an option to acquire up to 800 units. The potential aggregate contract value is more than $3.3 million, Cycomm said.
The units will be installed in police vehicles in Philadelphia as part of the upgrading of the city's police departments and other public safety agencies.
